The use of GAI to do background research or identification of core concepts is really risky. LLMs are consensus machines. To use one to try to derive relevant research questions implies that the underlying model is correct, which we know to be untrue. GAI 'wants' to agree with you, so the choice of prompt influences the outcome and is not equivalent to undertaking literature review. Summarising text is also risky insofar as GAI struggles with nuance and ambiguity. I have seen student work where very odd aspects have been emphasised, presumably as a result of their prompt usage. Critical use of GAI with a pragmatic relativist perspective may lead to some useful insight but it is not what students want to be trained to do
